title: Alder's Leave: Steel
introNarration: Edge oils a practice blade, sets it on the rack, and sends you to Alder. "Talk to Headmaster Alder in the High Study. Type up from the Great Hall. If he is still sending you down the Clock Tower stair, finish that first. When he says the grounds will teach the rest, come back and talk to me."
reminderNarration: Talk to Alder in the High Study, then come back and talk to Edge. The mail is still hanging, oiled and unromantic.
completionNarration: College lessons in this hearth are complete. Edge inks the leave in the Primer. Keep the book. Each new lesson grants one ink. Eat something warm before you take a cold road.

objectives.label: Return and talk to Mentor Edge.
